turns.content: I've been experimenting with home automation. Smart bulbs, thermostat, that kind of thing.
Home automation is genuinely useful once it's set up well. What platform are you using?
Home Assistant running on a Raspberry Pi. I wanted something local and not dependent on cloud services.
Home Assistant is the right choice if you care about privacy and reliability. Steep learning curve though.
Very steep. But the flexibility is worth it. I've got voice control and automations for the morning routine.
Once the morning routine automation is working it becomes one of those things you can't imagine living without.
Next project is adding some door/window sensors for a basic security layer.
Zigbee sensors pair nicely with Home Assistant and battery life is excellent. Worth considering.
